mapper.select: SELECT id, path_id, title, description, duration_days, sort_order, is_locked, created_at FROM path_stages WHERE path_id = #{pathId} ORDER BY sort_order ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO path_stages (path_id, title, description, duration_days, sort_order, is_locked, created_at) VALUES (#{pathId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{durationDays}, #{sortOrder}, #{isLocked}, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE path_stages SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, duration_days = #{durationDays}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, is_locked = #{isLocked} WHERE id = #{id}
